scenario: `30_s` (no whitespace) is a duration literal per LGRA.12.6.1; `30` alone is an integer. Pin: both `30_s` and `30` are accepted in different positions without ambiguity — duration in `within` clause, integer in `where` clause.
rules_ds:
schema Ev scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    ts: Time
    v: Int mutable

schema Out scope logical:
    dummy: Int key

rule r:
    Ev
    then Ev b within 30_s where b.v == 30
->
    emit Out logical dummy: 0
